summary: Wolf Camp Butte wooden L-4 lookout over the Salmon River, Clackamas County, Oregon; removed or destroyed in 1955; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1955 per the register; firelookout.com says destroyed that year; the Oregon Lookouts page gives no date

events.note: Register says removed in 1955; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1955

evidence.supports: wooden L-4 tower built in the 1930s overlooking the Salmon River, removed in 1955
evidence.quote: A wooden L-4 tower was constructed overlooking the Salmon River in the 1930s, and was removed in 1955.

evidence.supports: register places the site in Mount Hood National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1955; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1955; the Oregon Lookouts page says removed with no year. The story reports the disagreement instead of choosing one word.

sources.title: Wolf Camp Butte Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Brief's elevation (1,433 m) matches the register; the brief lacked design and agency-level detail, which were added. The 1930s build date is a decade only, so no build year is recorded. A user-written geocache listing (GC36BYJ, Sherar Burn) reportedly describes surviving footings and a survey benchmark, but fetch_text returned only its title, so that claim is not used. No staffing or fire sources were found, so none appear in the story. Access is not stated by any source beyond PeakVisor's wilderness placement, so no access key is recorded.
